gaps.sentence: He did it ___ purpose, not by accident.
Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.
___ reference to your letter of 12 May, we are still processing the claim.
gaps.explanation: 'With reference to' introduces the subject of a formal letter.

gaps.sentence: She opened the letter ___ trembling hands.
I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: ___ comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
___ the circumstances, the committee chose leniency.
The evidence establishes guilt ___ reasonable doubt.
gaps.explanation: 'Beyond reasonable doubt' — the legal standard of proof.
